# resolver by .github/scripts/check-dependencies.sh.

#   module                               version   justification

# `*` means any version Dependabot proposes, reviewed as a normal PR. An exact
# version means pinned: upgraded by hand, from a clean directory, never by a bot.
# Entries are added when a dependency is decided, not when it is first imported.
